answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit tied to a verified, rate-limited identity credential, with slashing for duplicate behavior. Like a terrace that only supports one structure per plot, the registry allows one active credential per verified device and payment proof, so creating many hollow shells costs real money each time. A shared reef of auditors samples behavior: if several identities act in lockstep, their deposits are frozen and investigated, making large fake fleets unprofitable while honest newcomers pay only a small, refundable bond.
